title: Jacky Godmann and Gabriel Nascimento Claim Silver at Canoeing World Championships
seoTitle: Jacky Godmann and Gabriel Nascimento win silver
subtitle: Duo takes silver in the C2 500m, completing Brazil's podium finishes at the event
excerpt: Jacky Godmann and Gabriel Nascimento won silver in the C2 500m, joining Isaquias Queiroz's gold in the C1 500m at the two-day competition.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Jacky Godmann and Gabriel Nascimento claimed silver in the C2 500m this Sunday (30), adding another Brazilian podium finish at the Canoeing World Championships.

The duo's silver medal joins Isaquias Queiroz's gold in the C1 500m, won on Saturday (29), completing the two Brazilian podium finishes recorded at the tournament.

With these results, the Brazilian national team demonstrates its strength in sprint events, reinforcing its presence in international canoeing competitions.

With information from Agência Brasil.
